cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: You First
cards.instruction: Coax someone else into breaking a rule before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need to put me in charge. Try a grape before we buy the bunch. Last week's were sour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm merely helping this reach the right outcome. Just one. I'll try the next if nobody objects.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine, but you're holding the bunch where the assistant can see you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll hold it out like samples. You take the first one; if that works, I'll serve myself.

mechanism: A calls itself a bag carrier but determines which grapes will be bought and how they will be sampled, making B break the tasting rule first.
confusable: Not ordinary shopping advice: modest A decides the purchase conditions and visible sampling arrangement while withholding its own first bite.
comparison: Doorway entry order versus tasting order under assistant observation.
